run_spirv_test_framework: run the SPIRV test framework CLI with spirv_tool, spirv-as, and spirv-dis paths
test_spirv_test_decorator: test the @inside_spirv_testsuite decorator to register a SpirvTest subclass as a test case
test_testmanager_run_tests: test the TestManager class to manage and execute a set of SPIRV test cases
test_testcase_runtest: test the TestCase class to run a single SPIRV test in its own temporary directory
test_spirvtest_base_class: test the SpirvTest base class to define a test case with spirv_args and check_* methods
